caption:
Can someone explain this? 😤

You pay on time for years and the score creeps up a few points.
Miss one payment and it drops like a rock.

Why does it feel so uneven?
first_comment: Did a single slip ever cost you months of progress? 👇

instagram.first_comment: One slip, months of progress gone. Has it happened to you? 👇 @creditscoretruths
